name: Relthus

features.name: Fey Ancestry
features.detail: Advantage vs charm, immune to magic sleep

features.name: Mask of the Wild
features.detail: Can hide when lightly obscured by natural phenomena

features.name: Favored Enemy: Goblinoids
features.detail: Advantage on Survival to track, INT checks to recall info about goblinoids

features.name: Natural Explorer: Forest
features.detail: Double proficiency on INT/WIS checks in forest terrain; not slowed by difficult terrain; can't be surprised while alert; find 2x food

features.name: Primeval Awareness
features.detail: Expend a spell slot: for 1 min/slot level, sense whether aberrations, celestials, dragons, elementals, fey, fiends, or undead are within 1 mile (6 in favored terrain). No number or location.

features.name: Hunter's Prey: Colossus Slayer
features.detail: Once per turn, +1d8 damage when hitting a creature below its HP maximum

known.name: Ensnaring Strike
known.detail: Bonus action on hit: STR save DC 12 or restrained by thorny vines, 1d6/turn; concentration

known.name: Hunter's Mark
known.detail: Bonus action: mark a creature; +1d6 damage on every weapon hit vs it; move mark when it drops; concentration, 1h

traits: Watches the tree line more than the road. Speaks in short sentences.
ideals: The wilds should be respected; those who despoil them answer to something older than any king.
bonds: Has a long memory for goblinoid raids on the communities he's wandered through.
flaws: Distrusts walls and rooftops. Indoors makes him restless.

notes: Wood Elf Ranger (Hunter). +7 longbow (Archery style). Favored terrain: Forest. Ammo: 25 arrows as of session 5 end (28 - 4 fired; recovered the bridge-ambush arrow while camped). Colossus Slayer: +1d8 once/turn vs wounded targets. Hunter's Mark and Ensnaring Strike are both concentration — pick one.
